news.title: Oil prices hold above $100 and Wall Street rebounds as US exchanges strikes with Iran - AP News
news.zh: 油價維持在100美元以上，美國與伊朗達成協議後華爾街反彈
news.impact: 地緣政治緩和推高油價，利好能源股和市場情緒

news.title: Euro zone inflation smashes through ECB target to 2.5% in March as energy costs soar - CNBC
news.zh: 歐元區3月通脹率飆升至2.5%，超越歐央行目標，能源成本飆漲
news.impact: 通脹壓力升溫，歐央行可能延遲降息，影響全球金融市場

news.title: China factory activity rebounds in March as Iran war looms over growth - AP News

news.impact: 製造業回暖但地緣政治風險升高，不確定性增加

news.title: Asian Stocks Wipe Out 2026 Gains as War Drives Inflation Worries - Bloomberg

news.title: Virgin Galactic Announces Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results and Provides Business Update - Virgin Galactic

news.title: Nexstar Stock Drops Sharply After Judge Puts Brakes On Tegna Merger - Deadline

news.title: This is what really causes recessions, a former top Trump White House economist says - CNBC
news.zh: 前川普政府白宮高級經濟學家解析經濟衰退真正成因

news.title: Japan Is Placing a Multibillion-Dollar Bet on the U.S. Housing Market - WSJ

news.title: Takeda begins US layoffs as part of massive $1.3B restructuring - Fierce Pharma

news.title: FTC Takes Action Against Match and OkCupid for Deceiving Users by Sharing Personal Data with Third Party - Federal Trade Commission (.gov)

news.title: AI chip startup Rebellions raises $400 million at $2.3B valuation in pre-IPO round - TechCrunch

news.title: Sysco to acquire Restaurant Depot for $29.1B - Restaurant Business Magazine
